nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.common.dixon_regions¶

Dixon anatomical region assignment from DICOM slice locations.

Regions (HEAD, THORAX, LEGS) are ordered by ascending slice coordinate: lowest centroid → HEAD, middle → THORAX, highest → LEGS.

DIXON_REGIONS
